cr_rule: A-17/A-18/A-21/A-22: reduction on the rate found (also DEFAULT), cutoff = same date ten years before the PARM date, openDate <= cutoff, floor on the reduced rate, effective-rate != 0 test. A-23 cites recalled CBACT04C (no age reduction) and keeps the wiki rule.
